ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with dominant high-intensity white regions comprising approximately 85% of the visible surface, bounded by low-intensity black margins along the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white field; low-intensity black bands along the trailing edge; vertical dark pixel streaks on the left lobe proximal to the margin; a singular low-intensity circular annulus located in the lower-mid quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 85-90 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys; most pronounced on the outer 50% of each lobe's trailing edge, showing jagged step-like transitions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the trailing edge, sweeping upward from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast, high-intensity white pixel groups (barnacles) located exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several low-intensity linear pixel disruptions; notably two near-vertical parallel streaks on the left lobe and multiple fine, multidirectional scratches distributed across the right lobe's white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark circular ring-shaped lesion on the ventral right lobe; extensive localized biological encrustation (barnacles) creating irregular topography at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black 'O' shaped mark on the interior white field of the right lobe, distinctive from surrounding pigment patterns.
